items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: Because Bob Dylan was there. And Joe Cocker was there.

ctx.x: And people danced to laptop beats, which are not generated even by human beings really.
In ’94 was the last festival? Because Bob Dylan was there. And Joe Cocker was there.
So people don’t really know music. You say there’s a lot of music, but there’s less and less music really. Live music.
